simple.meaning: תְּלוּנָה (tᵉlûwnâh) is a Hebrew action word meaning “a grumbling.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 9 times in Exodus, Numbers, beginning at Exodus 16:7. The surrounding contexts include Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to תְּלוּנָה (H8519) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: תְּלוּנָה (tᵉlûwnâh) / H8519 is traced through Exodus 16:7, Exodus 16:8, Exodus 16:9, Exodus 16:12 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.full: H8519. tluwnah [ תְּלֻנָּה ] noun feminine murmuring ; — plural construct תְּלֻנּוֺת ( תְּלוּנֹּת ) Exod 16:12 2 t.; suffix תְּלֹֻנּתֵיכֶם 16:7 3 t.; תְּלוּנֹּתָם Numbers 17:25; — murmurings of Israel against ׳י (only P); 16:9 , 12 ; Numbers 17:25; followed by עַל 16:7-8 , compare 16:8 , Num 14:27 ; Numbers 17:20 ( + על מַלִּינִם ).
definitions.rootNote: or תּלֻנָּה ; from 3885 in the sense of obstinacy ;

occurrences.englishText: In the morning, you shall see Yahweh’s glory; because he hears your murmurings against Yahweh. Who are we, that you murmur against us?”

Moses said, “Now Yahweh will give you meat to eat in the evening, and in the morning bread to satisfy you, because Yahweh hears your murmurings which you murmur against him. And who are we? Your murmurings are not against us, but against Yahweh.”
